componentName.description: If specified, this will be the name of the component entity created.

componentId.description: If specified, the id of the component entity created.

actionRequirement.description: The action requirement for the component

allowCrossRuntimeCalls.description:
If this is set to true, then the component will allow cross-runtime calls.
By default, cross-runtime calls will not be attempted, and instead a
runtime error will be raised.
If this is set to true, then the component creator should ensure that the
inputs/outputs of the component are serializable/non-native values.
